defective_pattern: Writing 'رگرسیون (نام متغیر)', 'باقیمانده (نام متغیر)', 'کل (نام متغیر)' in regression ANOVA summary tables.
why_defective: Redundant parentheticals cause clutter, distort table width, and deviate from Persian academic dissertation guidelines.
corrective_remedy: Simplify the row labels to: First row: '[Criterion Variable Name]' (e.g. 'رفتارهای خودآسیبی'); Second row: 'باقیمانده'; Third row: 'کل'. Repeat identically for any other criterion variables in the table.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detect any regression ANOVA table containing /باقیمانده\s*\(|کل\s*\(|رگرسیون\s*\(/ in row headers.
